notes.title: The next major update
notes.notes:
The next update will be an epic one, which will significantly adjust many aspects of the game. For example, the bond for [Spirits] has been modified to: After each attack, randomly gain or apply 1/3/8/24 gold, luck, vitality, poison, or weakness; [Vampires] will regain an additional 3/8/20/60 health whenever they deal damage; for every 10 damage dealt, permanently increase damage multiplier by +0.01/0.02/0.03/0.05 (provisional, not final version), and so on. Currently, we are intensely balancing and debugging, so please stay tuned and look forward to the new version coming soon!

notes.title: Minor Update v0.856
notes.notes:
1.You can now see the growth value of the spirit plants.
2.The original growth level will be correctly retained when upgrading stars.
3.A prompt next to battlefield synergy information indicates that each star level of a piece provides 1 synergy member.
4.Attempted to fix the occasional issue of incorrect enemy attack rounds. If you encounter this bug again, please send a screenshot to 2893067395@qq.com.
5.When recruiting, if the piece is not in the collection, the word "New" will be displayed next to it.
6.When recruiting, the probability of pieces of each quality will be displayed.
7.Fixed the misalignment in the description of the Water Spirit.
8.Fixed the bug where 3-star cavalry and regular soldiers could not evolve without enhancement.
9.Various other optimization adjustments.

notes.title: Little update Version 0.853
notes.notes:
1.Adjusted the display of messages. Annoying messages, goodbye!
2.Fixed an issue with Crimson Angel in the illustrated handbook.
3.Corrected the incorrect description of the Toxicity Bond in the illustrated handbook.
4.Improved the racial descriptions in the illustrated handbook.
5.Enhanced some skill descriptions to display the activation times. (A batch has been completed, with a small portion remaining to be done.)
6.Fixed a few known bugs.
7.Made some other optimizations and adjustments.

notes.title: Minor update
notes.notes:
1.Fixed the issue with incorrect promotion values for Empire Warriors
2.Lowered the difficulty in the early stages
3.Fixed bugs for Elemental Spirits
4.Other minor fixes
5.Other optimizations

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.notes: This update includes artistic optimizations in many areas of the game, some gameplay mechanism improvements, and enhancements to the tutorial.

notes.title: 0.82 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1.Optimized and enhanced the strength of Empire Warriors. Empire Warriors, let the battle begin!
2.New feature in the codex: Click on the star rating to view the piece attributes at different star levels.
3.Upgrade function: Added right-click option to revert upgrades.
4.Optimized some other areas.
5.Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
1.Attempted to fix a bug that may occur when combining the Shrewd Merchant + Street Vendor into the Legion Tycoon.
2.Made some optimizations in other areas.
